property_summary: The transfer function must return true when all external transferFrom calls succeed; the buggy version always returns false after successful transfers, violating the invariant that a non-reverting call returns true.
For any input where the call does not revert, the return value of transfer must be true (success); the buggy version returns false when all external transferFrom calls succeed.

For all admissible inputs where transfer does not revert, the return value must equal the success of the last external transferFrom call; the buggy version always returns false, violating this equivalence.
